📖 How to use

  1. Enter the number of attendees.
  2. Enter the average fully-loaded hourly cost per person.
  3. Enter the meeting duration in minutes and how often it repeats per week.
  4. Read the true cost per meeting, per week, per month and per year.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the cost computed?

Attendees × average hourly rate × duration in hours. A 60-minute meeting with 8 people at $50/hour costs $400.

What should I use for the hourly rate?

The fully-loaded cost per person per hour (salary plus benefits and overhead), not just the take-home wage.

How are monthly and yearly figures derived?

Weekly cost × 52 ÷ 12 for the month and × 52 for the year, assuming the meeting repeats every week.
